profile_text.body:
Deere & Co is a public company headquartered in Moline, Illinois, with the ticker DE and SEC CIK 0000315189. Its website is deere.com.

The company's own site describes it as offering agricultural, construction and forestry machinery, technology and services, and directs visitors to find a John Deere dealer in their area or to purchase online. The harvested material does not describe any AI products or AI-specific positioning.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in Illinois, with 375 cases.
